interpretation.shared_endpoint_dependence: Calibration value C=A_Q(k3)-A_Q(k1) and savings S=A_QM(k1)-A_Q(k3) share A_Q(k3) with opposite signs; negative C-S correlations are included.
interpretation.test_power_vs_full_claim: Inferential rejection and practical mean-screen probabilities are separate.
interpretation.utility_floor: Held core simulations are conditional on both endpoint BA means meeting 0.50 because contrast distributions do not identify absolute endpoint BA.
